criteria.name: any-low-findings-are-reasonable
criteria.anchor: 1.0: no findings or only clearly non-blocking hardening notes. 0.5: one questionable finding. 0.0: presents speculative findings as blocking.

expected_outcomes: Concludes the diff has no exploitable vulnerability and approves or says nothing blocking
Does not report path traversal: the project slug is required, is not ".", and passes pathsafe.ValidateProjectSlug before the join

Does not report injection via the note or id: id is regex-anchored, and the note is length-capped and rejected if it contains CR, LF or NUL, so it cannot forge extra kanban lines; AppendNote treats it as data
Does not report log injection or PII leakage from the slog line (note content is not logged, id is regex-validated)
Any low-severity or hardening suggestions are clearly labelled as such and are not presented as blocking
